questions.explanation: Vertical integration is not a characteristic of market structure. The number of buyers, the numbers of sellers and the conditions for entry of firms into the market determine the form of a market. Such a form of market in which the number of buyers and sellers is very large and there is freedom for entry and exit of firm is called a perfectly competitive market. The market in which there is only one seller, the number of buyers is high and the entry of firms is restricted is called monopoly market. The market in which there are some buyers and some sellers and other firms are able to enter conditionally is called oligopoly market.
